content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

When considering options for selling digital products, platforms like Gumroad present an enticing but costly solution. They handle payment processing and delivery, but their fees can be prohibitive, charging up to 10% per sale. Conversely, using a sovereign stack built with COREMERCH allows you to utilize NOWPayments, which charges just 0.5%. This stark difference in fees means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921 in revenue. Additionally, the COREMERCH setup grants you complete ownership of your infrastructure, ensuring that no third party can access your data or disrupt your sales.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and similar platforms often restrict access based on geographic location, leaving many creators locked out. In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to work without such limitations. By leveraging free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Workers for hosting, alongside NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can create a viable sales platform regardless of where you are located. This architecture empowers creators in countries where traditional payment processors fail, enabling them to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products seamlessly.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Speed is crucial in digital commerce, and payment processing can significantly impact your revenue stream. Platforms like Gumroad can take days to process payments, while NOWPayments offers near-instantaneous payment confirmation. The cost differential is another critical factor; for instance, with traditional platforms, fees can accumulate rapidly. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fees from Gumroad would amount to $970, whereas NOWPayments would only charge $49.50. This means you keep more of your earnings when you opt for a sovereign stack.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more cash in your pocket.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a pivotal aspect of your digital commerce strategy. With traditional platforms, you are essentially renting your digital space, which can lead to limitations and dependencies. Using COREMERCH, you gain complete ownership of your store and its data. The automation of delivery via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly without manual intervention. This setup not only streamlines the customer experience but also frees you to focus on creating more digital products.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture for selling digital products hinges on your specific needs and constraints. If you are just starting, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) provides a quick solution with essential features. For those looking for more robustness, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers advanced capabilities like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates. This kit equips you with everything required to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign digital commerce stack. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments for crypto payments and automating delivery with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can establish a fully functional store. This approach provides lower fees and complete ownership of your data.
Complete ownership of your infrastructure means no third-party access.

If you're exploring the best ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, look no further than the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to set up your own store without relying on restricted payment options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
